restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบางเขน
text: The dentist is lovely and speaks very well. She advised and answered all my questions. I just had my wisdom tooth extracted yesterday. At first, I was very worried and scared, but the dentist talked to me and reassured me not to worry. She applied and injected local anesthetic very well. The injection hurt a little. During the extraction, the dentist was very gentle, perhaps because my case wasn't difficult. After the extraction, I had no pain or swelling at all. I can still eat normally, and there's no pain at all from the wound. I highly recommend this clinic to everyone. The service is excellent, starting from the counter. Overall, it's great and the quality of service is excellent. If you're looking for a dental clinic, I highly recommend this dentist's clinic. ❤️❤️🫶🫶

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบางเขน
text:
The doctor was very kind and friendly, knowing that patients are afraid of pain.
But he spoke slowly and gently, reassuring the patient and making them feel less afraid.
(Because my daughter had a bad experience with a tooth extraction elsewhere.) My daughter said this time was great; the doctor was gentle, there was no pain or swelling. Excellent!

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบางเขน
text:
This dental clinic is located next to the Krung Thai Bank, just past the traffic light, across from the market and 7-11. I happened to be driving my motorcycle, so I parked next to the bicycle parking area.
The service counter was decent, and the dentist and assistants were friendly and provided a clear diagnosis.
They gave me good advice. Today, I came to check on my aching tooth.
I wondered whether to have it treated or extracted, so I had an x-ray taken. I decided to have it extracted. The anesthesia was good and painless. The extraction was precise and well-timed. It came off in a flash. Oh my god, it was so easy.
The clinic is clean, they screen for diseases, and they clean after the procedure. They are high-quality and experienced.
Reliable.
You can use your social security benefits of 900 baht per year (no additional x-rays).

text:
I got my crowns here, but ended up having to pay extra for a retainer!!
On the day I got my crowns fitted, I took my retainer to the dentist to have it adjusted to fit the new appliance. However, the dentist couldn't do it, and even after adjusting it, it still wouldn't fit. The dentist insisted it would! Even though I put it on myself, it still didn't feel like it was supposed to fit properly. He told me to get a new retainer and then quickly turned off the shop lights, as if he was trying to chase away customers.
I felt really bad after seeing this.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมบางเขน
text: I went to get two teeth filled, and both teeth still have problems. The doctor doesn't like to explain things, doesn't tell the patient what he's doing, and doesn't give the patient a chance to ask questions. Everyone in the clinic, both the doctor and the people at the counter, both men and women, are extremely unfriendly. They don't offer any hospitality to the patients. The service is as if the patient is asking for free dental treatment. - Bad dentists and bad service. I will never go there again.

text:
Thank you, doctor, for taking the time during lunch to come and extract my tooth. The doctor gave me excellent advice about my teeth. He was gentle and not too harsh. The price was reasonable.
Thank you for treating my teeth.

text: Excellent work! The dentist has a very gentle touch, and the service is like being part of the family. The dentist is attentive to every step of the process, works very quickly, and the price is affordable. My teeth look beautiful now!
